name: Band Tricep Pushdown
instructions: Anchor a resistance band overhead, hold the ends with your elbows bent and tucked at your sides.
Push your hands down until your arms are fully straight.
Pause, then let your hands rise slowly back to the start.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
image_prompt_scene: Standing with a band anchored overhead and the elbows bent at the sides.
